description_sq:
Shesim Apartament 3+1 ne Qender te Tiranes.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 5 te nje ndertimi 6 katesh i viteve 2000 dhe pa ashensor, disponon nje siperfaqe totale prej 107.9 m2, nga te cilat 95.5 m2 jane pjese e siperfaqes se brendeshme dhe 12.4 m2 jane pjese e siperfaqes se perbashket.
Organizohet ne 1 sallon ndenje me kendin e gatimit dhe te ngrenies relativisht te vecuar, 3 dhoma gjumi dhe nje tualet. 
Lokacion perfekt pasi ndodhet ne nje distance prej vetem 50 metra nga Sheshi Skenderbej. 
Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor. 
Per nje vizite ne prone jeni te mirepritur te na kontaktoni!
title_en: 3+1 apartment in the center of Tirana!
description_en: We are selling a 3+1 apartment in the center of Tirana. The apartment is located on the 5th floor of a 6-story building from the year 2000 and without an elevator, it has a total surface of 107.9 m2, of which 95.5 m2 are part of the internal surface and 12.4 m2 are part of the common surface. It is organized in 1 living room with a relatively separate cooking and dining area, 3 bedrooms and a bathroom. Perfect location as it is located at a distance of only 50 meters from Skenderbej Square. Has regular mortgage documentation. For a visit to the property, you are welcome to contact us!
